name: NEO v1.6.2
body:
Brighter Interface is in the View menu now without Show More Features on (and on Pocket’s ⋯ sheet).

Bug fixes:

[#479]: the Windows portable .exe no longer installs NEO when you quit. Help → Check for Update shows the release page for it. 
[#471]: splitting a chapter, dropping a card on another chapter, or turning a card into a chapter no longer adds the moved words to today's word count
[#460] screenplays keep --, ... and a spaced hyphen as typed. Books still get the dash and ellipsis.
[#474] the “can’t save in your library folder” check now tries up to three times and ignores a test file it can’t delete.

Merged PRs [#456], [#457], [#458], [#468], [#469], [#472], [#465] and [#480].

name: NEO v1.6.1
body:
• Editor: soft hyphen and non-breaking marks share one tint, painted behind the text (#420)
• Editor: soft hyphen marks are a wider light tint, like the other non-breaking marks (#420)
• Editor: soft hyphen marks are a tinted patch with a darker centre line, easier to see (#420)
• Editor: soft hyphen marks follow a paragraph's alignment, poetry and flush (#420)
• Update es.json to 1.6.0
• [#445] fix: Chapter Heading with no title
• Darlings: a book opened from the shelf shows its own snapshots (fixes #448)

name: NEO v1.6.0
body: A few PRs merged and bugs fixed. NEO seems really stable to me right now and has all the features I ever wanted. Happy writing, everyone!

name: NEO Pocket — latest build
body:
NEO Pocket is an early alpha. It's an Android companion to NEO for writing on the go.

This is a rolling build from `main`, and it updates itself every time Pocket changes, so this link is always the newest.

To try it on your Android phone, download `neo-pocket.apk` below and open it (Android will warn about installing outside the Play Store). On first launch, Pocket asks for All files access so it can read the NEO Library folder. Your books live in `Documents/NEO Library`; to share them with desktop NEO, sync that folder with [Syncthing](https://syncthing.net). Updates install straight over the old version.

Meant for a hardware keyboard; the on-screen keyboard stays down (long-press ☰ to open it). Swipe from the left edge for chapters, from the right for Notes & Comments. It's rough; please report bugs in [Issues](https://github.com/hughhowey/neo/issues).
